description: The system provides end-to-end architectural analysis and diagramming for codebases across multiple programming languages. The static analysis engine extracts syntax trees, call edges, and symbol tables, which are then clustered, enriched by LLM-backed scoping agents, and evaluated against codebase health rules. Orchestrated through CLI commands and workflows, the resulting architectural models and relationship graphs are compiled into interactive diagrams and documentation reports.
